name: fluxpoint
description: Flux Point engineering harness: one Definition of Done, one Evidence discipline, two drivers. Loop mode runs a deterministic Stop-hook DoD gate over one agent's cycle; graph mode compiles a declarative WORK.md IR into verified multi-agent campaigns. The harness decides done, never the agent.

interface.shortDescription: Definition-of-Done gate, per-edit verification, attestation and ratchets for one agent's loop; compiled multi-agent campaigns on Claude Code.
